notes.title: One week until the release
notes.notes:
We have great news! The game will be available on August 19. Now, we are working hard to make it as polished as possible.
Another news is a change of the game's target audience from 17+ to 18+ players. 
Yeah, Ecchi Jack will be a hentai game. But don't worry, if you don't want adult content you can always enable the censor mode in game's settings.

notes.title: The release is delayed
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone. I would like to apologize for the delay. Right now the game is playable, but it is still too early to present it to players.

I'll announce the new release date soon.
